_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DGUDhJ5QnVKq4qCnWNU4hzC)_

Fixes #30159

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么:pm-dispatch 全体座位不变量删去「唯一例外 MCP `rerun_failed_jobs`」,改写为 CI 红单次重跑也经中继 `rerun-failed.mjs`、先核 head;platform-readings 一行改称中继重跑,事实不变。
- 为什么改:其余文本与工具都只允许经中继重跑,这条旧例外读起来仍像一张 MCP 写许可。
- 风险与回滚:只改两行说明文字,行数不变,无代码;回滚 revert 本提交即可。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 第 94 行;`references/platform-readings.md` 第 286 行。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n rerun_failed_jobs -- .claude/` 应无输出。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` L94: the seat invariant names no MCP write exception; the one CI-red re-run leaves through the relay (`rerun-failed.mjs`), head checked first. Same line, so the file stays at 319 lines (ceiling headroom 0 unchanged).
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` L286: the merge-ref fact is respelled to the relay's re-run (`rerun-failed.mjs` → `run_rerun_failed` in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`); the fact itself is kept.

## Tests
Text-only `.claude/**` diff; no tests touched.

## Acceptance notes
- `git grep -n rerun_failed_jobs -- .claude/ AGENTS.md` is now empty.
- Other `.claude/**` / `AGENTS.md` text near "MCP" + re-run: `platform-readings.md:120` is a recorded reading (REST `rerun-failed-jobs` 403 vs MCP 201), not a grant. Left as is; not widened.
- `.claude/**`-only diff ⇒ not published ⇒ `skip-changeset`.
